sections.title: باب 7 — متن (7)

paras.text: … do. Even if the war is between two individuals, all relationships are affected by it and the whole tribe or family is affected. Finally, for a long time hatreds and enmities remain, which have a negative effect on development and the creative process. When people are in a state of war, then after the war economic backwardness and poverty become their fate. Much struggle has to be made for rehabilitation, because due to war their businesses are ruined and people suffer loss of life and property. The result of war is darkness, and conflict is the enemy of light. Because of war ignorance increases, because the continuity of children’s education ends. When there is no education and employment too is affected, traditionalism takes root. Social disorder too is among the results of war. Cooperation and brotherhood end. Feelings of revenge grow, and this becomes the cause of another dangerous war.

paras.text: The effect of conflicts, differences and wars within the country appears in the form of poverty. The economic structure is destroyed. A nest has to be built again by collecting straw by straw, which is a laborious task. Because of war unemployment and inflation increase, and finally poverty becomes the fate of nations. As a result of war education is affected. Educational institutions are damaged, as happened in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. Among students restlessness, despair and insecurity increase, and attendance in educational institutions falls. The result appears in the form of an increase in traditionalism and ignorance. After war extremist and vindictive thinking may increase further. After war there is also lawlessness for a period. Because of wars at the national level innocent people also suffer financial and human loss. Political instability too is among the results of wars.

paras.text: At the world level the effects of wars are of importance. After wars feelings of revenge arise, which become the cause of some dangerous clash. Insecurity and revenge compel nations to the arms race. Its bright example is the nuclear arms race in North Korea, Iran, Pakistan, India and China etc. Wars between nations as a result become the cause of world terrorism and extremism. After wars economic crises arise. Not only the defeated countries but the winners too face economic crisis. After World War Two Britain was among the winners, but it was so war-stricken that Britain gave independence to many colonies. The events after wars also become the cause of political upheaval …

… do. Even if the war is between two individuals, all relationships are affected by it and the whole tribe or family is affected. Finally, for a long time hatreds and enmities remain, which have a negative effect on development and the creative process. When people are in a state of war, then after the war economic backwardness and poverty become their fate. Much struggle has to be made for rehabilitation, because due to war their businesses are ruined and people suffer loss of life and property. The result of war is darkness, and conflict is the enemy of light. Because of war ignorance increases, because the continuity of children’s education ends. When there is no education and employment too is affected, traditionalism takes root. Social disorder too is among the results of war. Cooperation and brotherhood end. Feelings of revenge grow, and this becomes the cause of another dangerous war.

National impacts:

The effect of conflicts, differences and wars within the country appears in the form of poverty. The economic structure is destroyed. A nest has to be built again by collecting straw by straw, which is a laborious task. Because of war unemployment and inflation increase, and finally poverty becomes the fate of nations. As a result of war education is affected. Educational institutions are damaged, as happened in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. Among students restlessness, despair and insecurity increase, and attendance in educational institutions falls. The result appears in the form of an increase in traditionalism and ignorance. After war extremist and vindictive thinking may increase further. After war there is also lawlessness for a period. Because of wars at the national level innocent people also suffer financial and human loss. Political instability too is among the results of wars.

International impacts:

At the world level the effects of wars are of importance. After wars feelings of revenge arise, which become the cause of some dangerous clash. Insecurity and revenge compel nations to the arms race. Its bright example is the nuclear arms race in North Korea, Iran, Pakistan, India and China etc. Wars between nations as a result become the cause of world terrorism and extremism. After wars economic crises arise. Not only the defeated countries but the winners too face economic crisis. After World War Two Britain was among the winners, but it was so war-stricken that Britain gave independence to many colonies. The events after wars also become the cause of political upheaval …

مقامی جنگوں کی وجہ سے سماجی گروہ اور رشتوں پر اثر پڑتا ہے۔ رشتے سب سے زیادہ متاثر ہوتے ہیں خصوصاً اُس وقت جب فریقین کا تعلق ایک قبیلے یا خاندان سے ہو۔ مقامی تنازعات میں کوئی بھی آسانی سے معتدل راستہ اِختیار نہیں کر سکتا۔ لہٰذا یہ کہنا صحیح ہے کہ مقامی تنازعات سے سماجی گروہ سب سے زیادہ متاثر ہوتا ہے۔ مقامی جنگوں اور تنازعات سے بچے، بوڑھے، خواتین اور معذور یعنی کمزور طبقہ یا گروہ بھی متاثر ہوتا ہے۔ اِن لوگوں کو دیکھ بھال اور سہارے کی ضرورت ہوتی ہے لیکن جنگوں کے دوران یا بعد میں ایسا کرنا مشکل ہو جاتا ہے اور اِس گروہ پر منفی اثر پڑتا ہے۔ کاروباری گروہ بھی متاثر ہوئے بغیر نہیں رہ سکتا۔ جب مقامی سطح پر لوگ جنگ میں مصروف ہوں تو اُن کے کاروبار اور دیگر کاروباری گروہ بھی نقصان کا سامنا کرتے ہیں۔ اِس کی ایک روشن مثال کراچی اور صوبہ خیبر پختونخوا میں بدامنی اور خودکش حملے اور دھماکے ہیں۔ اِن کا بے حد اثر کاروباری گروہ پر پڑا ہے اور خرید و فروخت میں نمایاں کمی واقع ہوئی ہے۔ جب مقامی سطح پر جنگوں کی بنیاد مذہب اور عقیدہ ہو تو اقلیتی مذہبی گروہ بُری طرح متاثر ہوتے ہیں۔ اُن کیلئے زمین تنگ کی جاتی ہے۔ کمزور معاشرتی طبقات اور مزدور کار لوگ بھی نقصانات کا سامنا کرتے ہیں۔

Identification of Groups Affected by Conflicts and Wars at Local, National and International Level

All people somehow or other become targets of wars and conflicts, but some groups come especially under the influence of wars and conflicts. The identification of these groups is being done below:

Local groups:

Because of local wars social groups and relationships are affected. Relationships are affected most of all, especially at that time when the parties belong to one tribe or family. In local conflicts no one can easily adopt a moderate path. Therefore it is right to say that the social group is most affected by local conflicts. Children, the old, women and the disabled, i.e. the weak class or group, too are affected by local wars and conflicts. These people need care and support, but during or after wars doing so becomes difficult and this group is negatively affected. The business group too cannot remain without being affected. When at the local level people are engaged in war, their businesses and other business groups too face loss. A bright example of this is the unrest and suicide attacks and blasts in Karachi and the province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. These have had a very great effect on the business group and a marked decrease has occurred in buying and selling. When the basis of wars at the local level is religion and belief, minority religious groups are badly affected. The land is made narrow for them. Weak social classes and labouring people too face losses.
